items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 22 at 12:03PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM
items.description:
Lingering pockets of dense fog continue to loom across portions
of the lower bays and gulf coast this afternoon. Galveston harbor
and areas along Bolivar are currently experiences the worst
impacts to visibility. Satellite imagery shows low stratus/fog
shifting southward with a pocket of clearer skies following it.
Visibility should slowly improve, generally north to south, over
the next few hours. However, mariners should continue to exercise
caution when navigating these isolated pockets of dense fog.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 22 at 12:35PM CST until November 23 at 12:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Matagorda Bay; Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX out 20 NM; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM; Waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX from 20 to 60 NM; Waters from High Island to Freeport TX from 20 to 60 NM
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt expected.

* WHERE...Portions of Gulf of America.

* WHEN...From 9 PM this evening to noon CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Caution flags and additional Small Craft
Advisories will be needed through mid week.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
